desc:
🛁 Welcome to Empty a Bathtub with a Spoon!

How to Play:
🥄 Scoop water out of the tub, one spoonful at a time
🪣 Fill your cup and pour it down the drain to earn cash
⬆️ Buy bigger spoons, bigger buckets and faster hands
🧸 Dig down through grime, bath toys, petals, foam and sand
🔌 Pull the plug at the bottom to finish the tub!
🫧 Earn Suds Tokens to unlock permanent upgrades
👥 Team up with up to 4 friends to drain it faster
🛁 Beat each map to unlock the next!

🏆 Race for the fastest time and the most water drained on the leaderboards!
💀 Try Brutal mode: no shop, just you and your spoon.

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Console and Tablet players
